paths.role: Basic vector retrieval without application lifecycle rules

result_contract.evidence: The basic vector path reports its top retrieved fixture without applying current-document policy.

paths.role: PostgreSQL retrieval with application lifecycle rules and bounded LLM assistance
paths.backend: PostgreSQL with pgvector plus application policy

result_contract.evidence: The application must bind its answer to the current migration bulletin after applying its own lifecycle rule.

paths.role: Cortrix processing and retrieval with an independent application resolver

result_contract.evidence: Cortrix retrieval evidence and the application resolver must independently support the current migration bulletin.

harness_paths.role: Harness tool path over the application-managed PostgreSQL backend
harness_paths.backend: PostgreSQL with pgvector plus application policy

result_contract.evidence: Harness must receive the same policy-bound result as path a1.
Harness must receive source-bound Cortrix output that remains subject to the application resolver.

code_responsibility.methodology: Freeze one input manifest, isolate every path, collect independent operation timing, and emit attributable receipts.
Own lifecycle validation, bounded LLM assistance in path a1, final field selection, cancellation, and resume decisions.
Own path b document processing, retrieval, ranked source identity, and observable retrieval evidence.

provider_usage.basis: A candidate run must report provider requests and a cost estimate from runtime receipts; this contract makes no pre-run cost claim.

cancel.requirement: Cancellation must stop new work and record the last durable state for every started path.

resume.requirement: Resume must continue only from verified durable state and must not count earlier timing as new work.

cleanup.requirement: Cleanup must remove scenario-owned runtime resources after success, failure, or cancellation.
